$comment: Chrome motion tokens, the one source (STYLE.md §8). tailwind-preset.cjs turns them into ease-* utilities, --ease-* variables and the animate-*-in entrances; src/components/motion.ts hands them to script. Entrances all run on ease.snap and end on the element's own values. Nothing overshoots: there is no spring curve. A view or the page only fades; a sent message glides up out of the composer on ease.snap and the rest of its turn fades up behind it. ease.fade controls text reveal timing. Pixel motion keeps its held-frame steps-* timing.
